rationale: load_tables records the 12,845-row medical_claims table. claim_volume by claim_status with the figure gives total volume, the status mix and claims_status_distribution.png. denial_rate uses adjudicated_claims because the spec restricts the denominator to claims whose adjudication has concluded and excludes pending claims; the component records numerator and denominator definitions. fraud_prevalence is not default-selected so it is added explicitly with all_claims, matching the whole-portfolio requirement (fraud_label has zero nulls). financial_summary covers billed, allowed and paid with sum_mean_quantiles to satisfy totals, means and distribution quantiles. monthly_trend is keyed on service_date_from (month the service began) with claim_count, and its output includes the unparseable_dates count; date columns are strings so parsing failures are possible. write_report enables show_denominators so every rate prints numerator/denominator, cite_artifacts so each figure traces to a saved artifact, and the synthetic_data and descriptive_only caveats the spec requires plus no_operational_use as a standard guard for synthetic descriptive output.
